title: PRD-05 City e-bike line, regular production
summary: Closed cost centre for the regular City e-bike production line; closed on 15 October 2026 with remaining transactions held in draft.
body:
Cost centre PRD-05 covered regular assembly operations for Northbridge Cycles' City e-bike line under owner [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR)]] and business unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. The cost centre was closed in Ledgerline on 15 October 2026 [^r1][^r10][^r12][^r13]. Any purchasing transactions saved against PRD-05 remain in Draft status with warning W-CC-114 and will not be transmitted to suppliers [^r14].

## Line closure and transition

Cost centre PRD-05 was closed on 15 October 2026 [^r1][^r10][^r12][^r13]. The closure required all open assembly orders tied to legacy frames to be settled or written off and work in progress cleared from the line side [^r10]. Physical inventory, obsolete jigs, and legacy frame fixtures from the closed PRD-05 line were transferred to the storage unit in Leeds [^r11].

Purchasing transactions entered against PRD-05 now remain in Draft status with warning W-CC-114 and are prevented from transmitting to vendors [^r14].

## Budgets and financial performance

Master data in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] records PRD-05 as CLOSED as of 2026-10-15 [^r1]. For period 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, PRD-05 has a budget of £600,000, committed spend of £410,000, and available budget of £190,000 [^r2][^r3].

PRD-05 quarterly budget history across 2025 and 2026 recorded the following allocations and commitments:
* 2025-Q1: budget £488,000; committed £287,576.69 [^r4]
* 2025-Q2: budget £655,000; committed £433,311.24 [^r4]
* 2025-Q3: budget £578,000; committed £339,676.14 [^r4]
* 2025-Q4: budget £522,000; committed £327,697.28 [^r4]
* 2026-Q1: budget £575,000; committed £453,266.71 [^r5]
* 2026-Q2: budget £647,000; committed £582,494.84 [^r5]
* 2026-Q3: budget £669,000; committed £633,285.12 [^r5]

## User assignments

According to [[data-users-and-approval-limits|Users_and_approval_limits]], cost centre PRD-05 serves as the default cost centre assignment for Purchase executive [[user-eclarke|Emma Clarke (ECLARKE)]] and Stores operative [[user-atanaka|Aiko Tanaka (ATANAKA)]] [^r6].

## Procurement activity

Historical purchase orders charged to PRD-05 include:
* PO/2026/00854 (2026-06-26): 5,400 units of TYR-27.5-TRK-2.25 from Bollin Tyre Co. Ltd for £118,972.80 gross [^r7].
* PO/2026/00856 (2026-06-26): 54,000 units of FST-SCR-M4X10-ZN from Tame Fixings for £11,016.00 gross [^r8].
* PO/2026/01033 (August 2026): major frame order totalling £2,384,390.40 [^r9].
* PO/2026/01037 (August 2026): stems order totalling £369,072.00 [^r9].
* PO/2026/01044 (August 2026): battery pack order for [[items-bat|BAT-* items]] totalling £246,240.00 [^r9].
